label: PF Backlog 581
title: Eventing SSOT (Go): alert policy - rules, throttle, escalation
body:
## Problem / why
Alert routing is inline in orchestration_context._POLICY; no persisted rules, throttling, or escalation.

## Goal / value
A policy engine mapping event type/severity -> channels with throttle and escalation (reusing the policy map).

## In scope
- Alert-rule store + evaluation; throttle/dedupe window; escalation to HIL/backlog on critical kinds.

## Out of scope
- Transport delivery (E5).

## Acceptance criteria
- Terminal/failed events route to configured channels; duplicate alerts are throttled; critical escalates.

## Verification / test plan
- Policy table unit tests; throttle test.

brief.problem: Alert routing is inline in orchestration_context._POLICY; no persisted rules, throttling, or escalation.
brief.what_adds: A policy engine mapping event type/severity -> channels with throttle and escalation (reusing the policy map).
brief.why: Alert routing is inline in orchestration_context._POLICY; no persisted rules, throttling, or escalation.

objective: A policy engine mapping event type/severity -> channels with throttle and escalation, replacing hardcoded orchestration_context._POLICY.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Alert rules map tenant_id, event_types, min_severity, channels, and throttle/escalation parameters.
AC-2: Alert evaluation suppresses duplicate alerts within sliding throttle_window_seconds and records suppressed count.
AC-3: Critical/escalate events trigger escalation channels and emit escalated alert notifications.
AC-4: PostgreSQL and in-memory alert stores provide tenant-isolated CRUD and thread-safe sliding throttle state.
AC-5: API endpoints for alert rules and policy evaluation enforce operator authorization and schema validation.
in_scope: PostgreSQL schema migrations (migrations/0027_alert_rules_policy.up.sql / down.sql) for alert_rules and alert_throttle_state.
Go alert policy engine in product-forge/go/edpdata/ (alert_rule.go, alert_policy.go, alert_store.go, memory.go).
REST API endpoints in api/routers/events.py with OpenAPI schema synchronization in api/openapi.json.
Unit, integration, and property tests for rule evaluation, throttle suppression, and escalation.
out_of_scope: External transport delivery implementations (covered in BI-PF-1270 / E5).
approach: - Policy table unit tests; throttle test.

prior_decisions: docs/EVENTING-ALERTING-SSOT-DESIGN.md: Alerting SSOT architecture sec 4, 5, 9 Phase 6; Go core with PostgreSQL SoR.
BI-PF-1265 Epic: System-wide eventing SSOT and decoupled subscription infrastructure.
existing_path: core/orchestration_context.py:11-21 (_POLICY dictionary with hardcoded alert types and channels)
assumptions: Slide-window throttle tracking by tenant_id + rule_id + fingerprint is stored in memory and persisted in alert_throttle_state table.
Default channel routing aligns with Notify, Email, Webhook, HIL, and Backlog channel types.
divergences: None. Extends inline hardcoded policy dictionary into fully persisted rule-based Go engine as specified in master design.

risks: MITIGATED: Rule evaluation latency during event dispatching -> Mitigated by caching active rules in memory and indexed lookups.
MITIGATED: Database downtime or connection loss -> Mitigated by hardcoded fallback default policy guaranteeing critical alerts are never dropped.
MITIGATED: Cross-tenant rule leakage -> Mitigated by tenant_id mandatory filter in queries and PostgreSQL FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.
